old_description: Built to Protect Your Facility, Improve Energy, & Keep Every Load Secure
about:
OTCO, Inc. was founded in 1988 in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, as a fourth-generation family-owned industrial contract sewing manufacturer. The company began with a focus on custom sewn products for demanding industrial applications and has operated continuously from its Wisconsin facility for over three decades.

The company specializes in heavy-duty industrial sewing and custom textile fabrication, producing items such as loading dock seals and shelters, lift table guards, bellow guards, and a wide range of custom bags including locking bank bags and HIPAA-compliant medical bags. All products are manufactured in their Wisconsin facility, where an experienced team handles everything from prototypes to production runs, offering branding options like sewn-in tags, silk-screen printing, and embroidery.

OTCO serves customers across manufacturing and industrial, warehousing and logistics, medical and healthcare, government and municipal, banking and financial services, education and institutions, and retail and commercial sectors. Their solutions address machinery protection, material handling, facility energy efficiency, secure document and cash transport, and institutional safety and organization.

The company emphasizes a hands-on, consultative approach—starting each project by listening to the customer’s application, environment, and priorities—to deliver custom-built, American-made solutions without pre-made shortcuts. They highlight decades of practical experience, consistent inspection at every production stage, and a commitment to on-time fulfillment as key differentiators.
